evidence.detail: do_jslint() calls eslint with no format or verbosity flags, producing default stylish output (~many lines per violation across all .js/.jsx files)
eslint supports --quiet (errors only), -f compact (one line per issue), and --max-warnings <n> — none currently passed

triage.fix_sketch: In dev.py do_jslint() (line ~273), append '--format', 'compact' to cmd before the file list. compact format emits one line per problem ('file:line:col: message [rule]') instead of multi-line stylish blocks, dramatically reducing output while preserving all issue info. Alternatively add '--max-warnings', '0' to hard-fail on warnings without changing output format.
triage.notes: Single-line change in dev.py. The eslint config (eslint.config.mjs) does not need modification.
